work_units.notes:
Short, scannable. Sections:
  # Cutting a BenchBox release
  ## The flow
    1. make release VERSION=X.Y.Z (bumps version, drafts changelog,
       opens PR)
    2. Review the PR. Edit the changelog.
    3. Squash-merge.
    4. git tag vX.Y.Z && git push origin vX.Y.Z
    5. release.yml builds and publishes to PyPI.
  ## Recovering from common failures
    - CI fails on main: fix on a branch, PR, merge.
    - Wheel content is wrong: adjust pyproject.toml/MANIFEST.in
      excludes, cut a patch release.
    - PyPI publish fails: check trusted-publisher config, retry
      with the next patch version.
  ## Reference
    - Source: Makefile (release target),
      .github/workflows/release.yml,
      scripts/generate_changelog_entry.py.
Style: myst markdown, frontmatter copyright header consistent
with sibling docs/operations/results-phase-2-runbook.md.
